sources.title: Green Belt
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Current Green Belt practice guidance explains grey-belt assessment, remaining-Green-Belt impact, sustainable-location and Golden Rules tests; grey-belt identification alone does not allocate a site or grant permission.

sources.title: NPPF Chapter 13: Protecting Green Belt land
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: NPPF Chapter 13 prioritises previously developed land before other grey-belt land when Green Belt release is necessary and sets conditions for development on grey-belt land.

sources.title: NPPF Annex 2: Glossary
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The NPPF definition of grey belt is a policy classification inside Green Belt and excludes land where other footnote-7 policies provide a strong reason to refuse or restrict development.

sources.title: Green belt Dataset
sources.verified_claim: The national Green Belt dataset provides mapped designated boundaries as a snapshot; the service warns that changes since annual LPA returns may not yet be reflected.

sources.title: Green belt core Dataset
sources.verified_claim: Green-belt-core groups Green Belt areas around urban areas, including London; core membership is context only and is not parcel-level grey-belt evidence.

sources.title: Planning Data API documentation
sources.verified_claim: Planning Data documents coordinate queries that can return intersecting planning constraints; exact coordinate/geometry intersection is required before assigning a Green Belt consideration to a parcel.

sources.title: NPPF Chapter 9: Promoting sustainable transport
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: NPPF sustainable-location tests require development patterns and site assessment to consider transport accessibility, safe access and network impacts; this is relevant to grey-belt sustainability but not a parcel approval.

sources.title: NPPF Chapter 11: Making effective use of land
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: NPPF promotes effective use of land and substantial weight for suitable brownfield land while retaining environmental and infrastructure safeguards; policy context does not establish candidate deliverability.
